heading: INT. TELEGRAPH OFFICE, CANAL LOCK HOUSE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. TELEGRAPH OFFICE, CANAL LOCK HOUSE - NIGHT
Lamplight, wet floorboards, a brass key clicking on the long oak counter.
Rain hammers the shutters.
Water is coming under the door in a slow, steady sheet.
ELIAS VANTERPOOL, forties, stout, the clerk in charge, bends over the key.
TOBIAS GRILL, twenties, his junior, stacks ledgers onto a high shelf.
WINIFRED HALE, fifties, the lockkeeper's widow, stands by the stove with a shawl over her head.
A girl, PRUDENCE, ten, sits on the counter with her boots held up out of the wet.
He taps out a line, stops, and taps it again.
He does not look up.
Upstream station says the gates at Marlow are gone. Everyone move your things up.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Gone how?
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Gone like gone.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: He grabs a ledger from the lower drawer and hands it up.
He takes it, but it is heavy and he nearly drops it.
Forty years of figures. Forty years, and we save the figures.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Prue, up on the shelf with you. Now, please.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: It's wet up there too.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: She is lifted anyway.
He sets her next to the ledgers and she hugs her knees.
Winifred, how long before it reaches the sill?
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: An hour. Less if the Anderton sluice stays open.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: He keeps tapping.
She watches him tap, and neither of them says what both know about the sluice.
Sir, I could run to the lock house and shut it.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: You could drown at the lock house.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: I could.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: He pulls his coat on regardless.
He is stopped at the door by a hand on his sleeve.
Not you, boy. I know the wheel. I'll go.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: Winifred --
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Elias, send your message.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: She wraps the shawl tighter and opens the door.
The rain comes in like a thrown bucket.
She is gone.
Elias bends to the key.
His hand is steady.
His jaw is not.
Should've been me.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Is she coming back?
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Elias taps.
Tobias stares at the door.
Nobody answers.
